sanskrit_verse: महापराधे दिव्यानि दापयेत् तु महीपतिः । अल्पेषु च नरः श्रेष्ठः शपथैः शापयेन् नरम् ॥
transliteration: mahāparādhe divyāni dāpayet tu mahīpatiḥ | alpeṣu ca naraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śapathaiḥ śāpayen naram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In great transgressions, the king shall cause divine restitution; in minor faults, the superior man shall invoke sanctions through oaths upon the inferior.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is hierarchically calibrated to the magnitude of the act
Causation is aligned with consciousness capacity, not mere physical action
Capacity-based responsibility determines the mode of enforcement
Restoration logic operates through proportional energetic alignment
Consciousness alignment is achieved via invocation and witnessing
executable_legal_axioms: IF transgression_magnitude = HIGH THEN enforcement_mode = DIVINE_RESTITUTION BY KING
IF transgression_magnitude = LOW AND actor_status = SUPERIOR THEN enforcement_mode = OATH-BASED SANCTION
IF actor_capacity < threshold THEN no autonomous liability is incurred
ALL enforcement MUST realign causal consciousness fields without punitive intent
RESTORATION is executed through witnessed completion, not coercive suffering
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, only those with sovereign consciousness calibration—those who embody universal dharma—are authorized to execute divine restitution. Lesser infractions are handled through integrity-compelling oaths under witness, preserving societal alignment without punitive degradation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality flows from conscious capacity, not physical event alone. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misalignment manifests sequentially through disintegrated awareness. Thus, responsibility is proportionally assigned based on consciousness maturity. Non-punitive reality is upheld by aligning the offender's field through witnessed commitment rather than imposed suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Divine Restitution Protocol: Initiated by sovereign authority to recalibrate collective energetic distortion
Oath-Based Reintegration: Invoked by higher-consciousness individual to restore lower-consciousness actor via witnessed vow
Witnessed Completion Process: Ensures full energetic closure through conscious acknowledgment
Integrity Reclamation Sequence: Facilitates return to original dharmic resonance through voluntary correction
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from consciousness, not coercion. The king enacts divinity; the wise invoke truth. There is no punishment—only alignment. Reality responds to awareness, not force. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
